ai_summary: **Executive Summary: Kennametal India Investor Meeting**  Kennametal India highlighted its metal cutting tools and machine solutions business, emphasizing strategic diversification into aerospace and general engineering to reduce reliance on the dominant 50-60% automotive sector. A key material impact identified is the reduced tooling demand from Electric Vehicles (EVs), contrasting with stable or increased demand from hybrid vehicles. While specific market share data was not disclosed, the company noted general confidence in domestic manufacturing activity, positioning tooling as a frequently replaced consumable directly tied to production volume.
